description:
## Repro

Put this in a scratch `*.sync.test.ts` in `packages/sanity/src/core/store/document/sync/` and pass it to `runSyncTest(syncTest)`, which rejects with `World did not settle within 40 rounds; inconsistent: A`.

## Failure signature

```
sync-gen-signature: World did not settle within N rounds; inconsistent [Unable to apply diffMatchPatch to target title]
```

## Repro

Put this in a scratch `*.sync.test.ts` in `packages/sanity/src/core/store/document/sync/` and pass it to `runSyncTest(syncTest)`, which rejects with `World did not settle within 40 rounds; inconsistent: A`. The lake records only the outside transaction.

## Failure signature

```
sync-gen-signature: World did not settle within N rounds; inconsistent
```

## Repro

The listener receives `Rejected with 409`.

## Failure signature

```
sync-gen-signature: unhandled rejections [Rejected with 409]
```

## Repro

The server's draft gets `_system: {base: {id: 'article-5', rev: 'seed'}}`, and `expectConverged` fails on A's view of the draft.

## Failure signature

```
sync-gen-signature: A view of drafts.article-N
```
